paradise.line: Where some have found their paradise
stanza: People will tell you where they've gone
They'll tell you where to go
But till you get there yourself
You never really know
Where some have found their paradise
Others just come to harm
So come back, Woody Guthrie
Now, come back to us now
Tear your eyes from paradise
And rise again somehow
If you run into Jesus
Maybe he can help you out
Come back, Woody Guthrie
To us now

paradise.line: Well, it seems like a sailor's paradise
stanza: Setting out on them high seas
Feels just like being born
But that first port call in Thailand
Feels like a pollywog turning nineteen
They've got king cobras fighting in boxing rings
And all the angels play Connect Four
Well, it seems like a sailor's paradise
But it turns out to be a bad dream

paradise.line: Why God, why God, do I gotta suffer? (Poverty’s paradise)
paradise.linePrev: Every stone thrown at you restin' at my feet
paradise.lineNext: Earth is no more, won’t you burn this muh'fucka?

paradise.songTitle: You’d Be So Nice To Come Home To
paradise.line: You'd be so nice you'd be paradise
stanza: You'd be so nice you'd be paradise
To come home to and love
Hi there, careful on the steps (Que viva Sevilla!)
Get a drink, have a good time now
Welcome to paradise (Paradise, paradise, paradise)
(Hey!)

paradise.line: We keep spendin' most our lives livin' in the gangsta's paradise
stanza: They've been spendin' most their lives livin' in the gangsta's paradise
They've been spendin' most their lives livin' in the gangsta's paradise
We keep spendin' most our lives livin' in the gangsta's paradise
We keep spendin' most our lives livin' in the gangsta's paradise
And the women all were beautiful
And the men stood straight and strong
They offered life in sacrifice
So that others could go on

sacrifice.line: I will gladly feed you to the breed who wants you sacrificed
sacrifice.linePrev: We pass around the pineapples and pull the pins in unison
sacrifice.lineNext: No pagan or sacrilege, just bacon for scavengers
